name: Sakuraoka Miharu
source:
Masato's Classmate. She is both the class representative and the vicepresident of the Student Council. Her character is a bit old-fashioned, which makes her look serious and a bit strict. She was named after "Sakurabi", a rocket weapon of the japanese navy.

Miharu is the main heroine of a fan disk released in 2006.
